description: Permanently delete a tax rate FROM THE WHOLE COMPANY. Takes the tax rate id from get_taxes. THIS CASCADES: the rate is stripped out of every tax group that lists it and all of its per-outlet percentages are deleted with it. Products in those groups immediately stop being charged this tax. This is almost never what a merchant means when they say "remove the tax from X" — that is remove_tax_rate_from_group. Use this one only when they say the rate should not exist at all any more. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING, naming the rate and listing every group it will disappear from. There is no undo and no way to recover the percentages. Sales already rung up are NOT recalculated — this only affects sales from now on.

taxRateId.description: Tax rate id from get_taxes — not a name

name: hub_delete_tax_rate
title: Delete tax rate
